column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran ketiga puluh sembilan ekor panjang.
# Bagian 3 dari lima berkas (70-74). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").
# --- klausa pendek ---
=Stability Break lasts for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Stability Break bertahan <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =Restores all Stability Index 2 turns after Stability Break.
column2: Memulihkan seluruh Stability Index 2 giliran setelah Stability Break.

column1: =Restores stability to full 2 turns after entering Stability Break.
column2: Memulihkan Stability sampai penuh 2 giliran setelah memasuki Stability Break.

column1: =Restore stability index.
column2: Memulihkan Stability Index.

column1: =Restore <color=#f26c1c>2</color> stability index.
column2: Memulihkan <color=#f26c1c>2</color> Stability Index.

column1: =Will not be automatically targeted by the enemy.
column2: Tidak akan otomatis disasar musuh.

column1: =Immune to movement debuffs.
column2: Kebal terhadap debuff pergerakan.

column1: =Immune to displacement, Mobility debuffs, and command prohibition effects.
column2: Kebal terhadap efek pemindahan, debuff Mobility, dan larangan perintah.

column1: =This effect can trigger a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>1 time</color> per turn.
column2: Efek ini bisa aktif maksimal <color=#f26c1c>1 kali</color> setiap giliran.

column1: =Activates once every 3 turns.
column2: Aktif sekali setiap 3 giliran.

column1: =Damage dealt to targets with <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> is increased.
column2: Damage ke target yang memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> meningkat.

column1: =Damage dealt to Paradeus units is increased.
column2: Damage ke unit Paradeus meningkat.

column1: =If only 1 target is hit, the damage multiplier increases further.
column2: Jika hanya 1 target yang terkena, damage multiplier naik lagi.

column1: =Deals physical damage and gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Memberikan physical damage lalu mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Cheyanne gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Cheyanne mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Belka gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Belka mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Belka gains <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Belka mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Mityl gains <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Mityl mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =Attacks 1 enemy unit, reducing their energy by 1 point.
column2: Menyerang 1 unit musuh, mengurangi energi mereka sebesar 1 poin.

column1: # --- link & summon ---
=Is linked to the <color=#f26c1c>Deichgraf - Festung</color>.
column2: Terhubung dengan <color=#f26c1c>Deichgraf - Festung</color>.

column1: =When this unit gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, the <color=#f26c1c>Deichgraf - Festung</color> gains <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Saat unit ini mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, <color=#f26c1c>Deichgraf - Festung</color> mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =When this unit is destroyed, the link effect is nullified.
column2: Saat unit ini hancur, efek tautannya ditiadakan.

column1: =Selects an enemy target and summons <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> to follow it.
column2: Memilih target musuh lalu memanggil <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> untuk mengikutinya.

column1: =Upon death, the <color=#f26c1c>Mammoth - Modified</color> gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Saat mati, <color=#f26c1c>Mammoth - Modified</color> mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =At the start of the turn, emerge and release captured ELIDs.
column2: Di awal giliran, muncul lalu melepaskan ELID yang ditangkap.

column1: =Released ELIDs can act immediately.
column2: ELID yang dilepaskan bisa langsung bergerak.

column1: # --- serangan ---
=Simultaneously, destroy destructible Cover within a <color=#f26c1c>3x3 area</color> around the user.
column2: Bersamaan dengan itu, menghancurkan Cover yang bisa dihancurkan dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 3x3</color> di sekitar pengguna.

column1: =The City Warden moves to the selected tile and attacks the closest enemy to Papasha, dealing Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>150%</color> of attack.
column2: City Warden bergerak ke tile terpilih lalu menyerang musuh terdekat dari Papasha, memberikan Physical damage setara <color=#f26c1c>150%</color> Attack.

column1: =Prioritizes attacking the nearest target using <color=#3487e0>[Gravity Oscillation - Sweep]</color>.
column2: Mengutamakan menyerang target terdekat memakai <color=#3487e0>[Gravity Oscillation - Sweep]</color>.

column1: =If under the effect of <color=#f26c1c>2 or more</color> Burn buffs, perform an additional attack on the original target, dealing <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>75%</color> of attack and <color=#f26c1c>2</color> stability damage.
column2: Jika sedang terkena <color=#f26c1c>2 atau lebih</color> buff Burn, melancarkan serangan tambahan ke target semula, memberikan <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>75%</color> Attack dan <color=#f26c1c>2</color> Stability damage.

column1: =If there are obstacles along the knockback path, applies <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> to the knockback target for <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Jika ada penghalang di jalur dorongan, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> ke target yang terdorong selama <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =Apply <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> based on the number of enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> of the selected target.
column2: Menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> berdasarkan jumlah unit musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 5 tile</color> dari target terpilih.

column1: =After the skill is used, triggers all enemies' effects of <color=#3487e0>{4}</color> and the on-death effects of <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>.
column2: Setelah skill dipakai, memicu semua efek <color=#3487e0>{4}</color> milik musuh dan efek saat-mati <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>.

column1: =After making an active attack, this unit cannot perform any more active attacks during this allied turn.
column2: Setelah melancarkan serangan aktif, unit ini tidak bisa melancarkan serangan aktif lagi pada giliran sekutu ini.

column1: =The damage multiplier increases based on the number of <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> stacks possessed.
column2: Damage multiplier meningkat berdasarkan jumlah stack <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> yang dimiliki.

column1: =This skill's critical rate is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> and deals additional fixed damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of defense.
column2: Critical Rate skill ini berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> dan memberikan tambahan fixed damage setara <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> Defense.

column1: =This skill's critical rate is reduced and deals additional fixed damage.
column2: Critical Rate skill ini berkurang dan memberikan tambahan fixed damage.

column1: =For every other allied unit within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color>, stability damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color>.
column2: Untuk setiap unit sekutu lain <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color>, Stability damage yang diberikan bertambah sebesar <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color>.

column1: =For every other allied unit within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color>, stability damage dealt is increased.
column2: Untuk setiap unit sekutu lain <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color>, Stability damage yang diberikan bertambah.

column1: =For every <color=#f26c1c>6 points</color> of initial max HP, critical rate is increased by <color=#f26c1c>0.1%</color>, to a maximum increase of <color=#f26c1c>60%</color>.
column2: Untuk setiap <color=#f26c1c>6 poin</color> Max HP awal, Critical Rate meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>0.1%</color>, maksimal naik sebesar <color=#f26c1c>60%</color>.

column1: =Critical damage against targets not protected by Cover is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.
column2: Critical Damage terhadap target yang tidak terlindungi Cover meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

column1: =During Stability Break, damage taken is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> and this unit is unable to receive stability restoration effects.
column2: Selama Stability Break, damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> dan unit ini tidak bisa menerima efek pemulihan Stability.

column1: =If a skill does not deal damage during the turn, gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Jika skill tidak memberikan damage pada giliran itu, mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =If any weakness is exploited, when healing allied targets, apply <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> to them.
column2: Jika ada kelemahan yang dieksploitasi, saat menyembuhkan target sekutu, menerapkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> kepada mereka.

column1: =Grants maximum enhancement if the target has Electric debuffs.
column2: Memberikan peningkatan maksimum jika target memiliki debuff Electric.

column1: =This enhancement cannot be triggered again if the skill has already been enhanced.
column2: Peningkatan ini tidak bisa aktif lagi jika skill-nya sudah ditingkatkan.

column1: =This skill can be used when <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> is in the <color=#3487e0>{4}</color> state.
column2: Skill ini bisa dipakai saat <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> berada dalam kondisi <color=#3487e0>{4}</color>.

column1: =<color=#f26c1c>Rank II</color>: The attack now deals <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> that ignores cover.
column2: <color=#f26c1c>Rank II</color>: Serangannya kini memberikan <color=#e67129>Burn damage</color> yang mengabaikan Cover.

column1: =Frost Barrier absorption amount is equal to <color=#f26c1c>130%</color> of Suomi's initial attack, but cannot exceed <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of the target's max HP.
column2: Daya serap Frost Barrier setara <color=#f26c1c>130%</color> Attack awal Suomi, tapi tidak boleh melebihi <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> Max HP target.

column1: # --- spesifik karakter ---
=After using <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, consumes all stacks of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> from the target, and Robella gains an equal number of stacks of <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>.
column2: Setelah memakai <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, menghabiskan seluruh stack <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dari target, dan Robella mendapatkan stack <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> sebanyak itu juga.

column1: =If Confectance Index is full, <color=#3487e0>Marzanna's Sanction</color> can immediately be used again.
column2: Jika Confectance Index penuh, <color=#3487e0>Marzanna's Sanction</color> bisa langsung dipakai lagi.

column1: =If a target with <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> is killed, the next time <color=#3487e0>Hunting Instinct</color> is used this round, <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> will be applied.
column2: Jika target yang memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> terbunuh, pada pemakaian <color=#3487e0>Hunting Instinct</color> berikutnya di ronde ini, <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> akan diterapkan.

column1: =After making an active attack, Soppo gains <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>.
column2: Setelah melancarkan serangan aktif, Soppo mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>.

column1: =Whenever Yoohee applies <color=#f26c1c>3 or more</color> <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, triggers <color=#3487e0>{3}</color> once, gaining <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{4}</color>.
column2: Setiap kali Yoohee menerapkan <color=#f26c1c>3 atau lebih</color> <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, memicu <color=#3487e0>{3}</color> sekali, mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{4}</color>.

column1: =When gaining <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color> or <color=#f26c1c>Negative Charge</color>, if the Beak Beasteel has <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color>, all skills treat it as having <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color> and vice versa.
column2: Saat mendapatkan <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color> atau <color=#f26c1c>Negative Charge</color>, jika Beak Beasteel memiliki <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color>, semua skill menganggapnya memiliki <color=#f26c1c>Positive Charge</color>, begitu pula sebaliknya.
